v4.6.49 — On IBKR, bots read the FULL universe but skip coins IBKR can't trade

✨ Universe filtering per broker
• A bot now reads its entire universe (e.g. your crypto universe with ONDO, RENDER, FIL, etc.) but automatically SKIPS the symbols the active broker can't trade. On IBKR (which lists only major coins) it trades the supported subset — BTC, ETH, BCH, LTC, AAVE, LINK, AVAX, XRP, DOT, ADA, DOGE — and skips ONDO and other unlisted coins, instead of falling back to a tiny default list or erroring.
• On Alpaca, everything in the universe is traded as before (full coin support).
• Each skipped symbol is checked once and cached, so there's no per-cycle slowdown, and the bot logs which symbols it skipped.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
